title: Foiled vulnerable-path hook manifest
description: One instrumentation hook (#32), stored as hooks/<id>.yaml and mirrored by foiled_core::hooks::HookManifest. Catalogue entries list hook ids in instrumentation_hooks. See docs/instrumentation.md.

id.description: Hook id. Must match the file name and the envelope hook.hook_id.

catalogue_ids.description: Catalogue entries this hook is baked into.

cve_id.description: The CVE (or synthetic FOILED-DEMO id) whose vulnerable path the hook watches.

kind.description: in_process: callback in a sandboxed app. emulator_checkpoint: checkpoint in a Foiled emulator (#30). ebpf_uprobe: host-side uprobe where stable (v0.2+).

transport.description: Where the host agent reads hook lines from.

trigger.description: Plain description of the vulnerable condition that fires the hook.

fields.description: Envelope hook fields this hook fills in.

request_slice.description: follow_store_payloads: hash only unless store_payloads is true (#16). hash_only: always hash only.

inline_cap_bytes.description: Largest slice kept inline in the envelope data. Larger slices go to R2 by request_slice_ref.

max_field_chars.description: Longest string field (paths, notes) the hook writes before truncating.

owner.description: Who maintains the hook code (a GitHub handle or team).

source.description: Repository path of the trusted hook code that is baked into the image or emulator.
